text:
Ben P: Vendor CloudMetrics billed TX sales tax on our hosted API charges (INV-2026-03 & INV-2026-04). They say they uploaded a resale cert but tax still applied. Can finance check?
Aisha (Finance): Do we have a signed Texas resale certificate on file (Form 01-339)? If yes, we can request retrospective credit but need vendor confirmation in writing.
CloudMetrics (VendorBot): Uploaded: cloudmetrics_01-339_signed_2025-10-15.pdf, buyer name = Redwood Inference, FEIN = 27-1234567, billing address = Austin, TX.
Tom H: Charges were on 2026-04-01 and 2026-05-01. Total tax billed = $2,460. Vendor already emailed saying they'd like the credit applied to future AR.
Aisha (Finance): Ok first pass looks good — buyer name and FEIN match. Please ask vendor to: 1) confirm they request credit for INV-2026-03 and INV-2026-04 and list amounts; 2) confirm the resale cert applies from 2025-10-15 onward; 3) state they acknowledge tax was billed in error and authorize Redwood to issue a credit memo. Use the boilerplate below.
Ben P: Sent vendor the boilerplate.
Aisha (Finance): Boilerplate to vendor:
```
Hi <Name>,
Thanks for the certificate. To process a tax credit we need a short written statement confirming: (1) you request a refund/credit for sales tax billed on INV-2026-03 ($1,230.00) and INV-2026-04 ($1,230.00); (2) the attached Form 01-339 (signed 2025-10-15) applies to transactions with Redwood Inference from 2025-10-15 onward; and (3) you acknowledge the tax was billed in error and authorize Redwood to issue a credit memo offsetting those invoices.
Once we receive that reply we'll create CM-2026-09 and update our account flags to prevent future TX tax.
Thanks,
Aisha
```
CloudMetrics (VendorBot): Vendor reply excerpt: "We confirm and request credit for $2,460.00 covering INV-2026-03 & INV-2026-04. Use attached resale certificate effective 2025-10-15. Please issue credit memo; apply to next statement."
Lina Z: We have the written confirmation. I'll prepare CM-2026-09 and set tax code TX-EXEMPT-RESALE on acct_abc123. ETA tomorrow EOD to post.
Ben P: Vendor prefers credit applied to next invoice rather than refund. OK?
Aisha (Finance): That's acceptable. Make sure credit memo references invoice numbers and include note with certificate metadata (signed_date=2025-10-15, doc=cloudmetrics_01-339_signed_2025-10-15.pdf). After posting, upload CM and update vendor master.
Ben P: @EngBillingBot can you flip the exemption flag for acct_abc123? Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1234
EngBillingBot: BILL-1234 created, assignee=Lina Z, due=2026-03-05.
Lina Z: Flag set. Will confirm on next invoice run.
Ben P: Thanks all, closing when CM shows and vendor acknowledges application to next statement.
Aisha (Finance): Logging under vendor tax exceptions and updating vendor file.
Tom H: Noted.
